description: This donut chart illustrates the distribution of nine different categories of "Stimuli Type," as indicated by the bolded text in the center of the ring. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, category labels and their exact percentages are positioned outside the chart, adjacent to their respective slices. Moving clockwise from the top right, the segments include a dark red slice with a label partially obscured by a semi-transparent grey rectangle that faintly reads "Draft/Other (28.5%)", a mauve slice labeled "Organizational Report (8.8%)", a light purple slice for "Event Posting (8.8%)", a dark navy blue slice representing "Interview (10.2%)", and a light blue slice for "Organizational Website (6.6%)". Continuing clockwise, there is a dark green slice labeled "External News Article (13.1%)", a thin light green slice for "Social Media Post (1.5%)", a large gold slice for "Press Release (21.9%)", and a very thin orange slice labeled "Intra-agency news article (0.7%)". The segments are not arranged in any strict ascending or descending order by size, and none of the slices are exploded or offset from the main ring.
